approvedSemanticMeaning: For this specifically certified synthetic-unit configuration, the approved bag has a certified hollow interior with a valid internal support floor on which this unit may physically rest.
strictScope: This authorization applies ONLY to the currently certified synthetic unit/configuration.
It does NOT establish a general rule that every bag has a usable interior.
It does NOT automatically authorize any other item to be placed inside the bag.
The bag remains opaque/closed to all other unsupported semantics.
The internal support floor must have its own explicit identity/lineage and validation evidence.
Placement must still pass the normal Geometry / Support / Ground Contact rules.
No hidden geometry inference or fallback is allowed.
No other item inherits this authorization.
Any future item requires its own applicable certified relationship or a separately approved generalized bag-interior contract.
status: SIGNED_SEMANTIC_AUTHORIZATION: records the owner's approval of the semantic MEANING only. The drafted records it covers remain pre-admission; R1 formal signoff still requires the validator matrix, deterministic fixture, authority audit and exact-review round per the Gate A lifecycle.
